description: Value and momentum are negatively correlated anomalies; combining high earnings yield (cheap) with strong 12-month momentum should capture both premia and smooth drawdowns, producing a higher forward Sharpe than either pure value or pure momentum; falsified if forward Sharpe is below the best pure momentum strategy in top1000 (currently 1.63 for 252d skip 21 top 50).
title: Value Momentum · 252d skip 21 · Top 1000 · Long Only
